_about: ROBOTIS Dynamixel XL330-M288-T, copied from duck-droids spec/actuators.json (2026-11-05), which took it from the ROBOTIS e-manual: 34 x 20 x 23 mm case without horn (box: long, wide, along the shaft), 18 g, 0.52 N m stall at 5 V, 103 rpm, 1:288.35. Rated torque about a third of stall (an estimate). Armature, damping and friction from microduck's identified actuator (pollen-robotics/microduck_rl joints_properties.xml, Apache-2.0). shaft_x: the shaft's offset from the case's middle along its length (an estimate in duck-droids: confirm on ROBOTIS's drawing). Mounting: M2 x 6 tap into the horns, M2 x 8 tap through the 4 frame holes. Price about $24: confirm before ordering.
